name: Set Zitadel Login Policy
description: Sets the instance login policy to a known-good state: password login as fallback, passkey allowed, MFA enforced for local logins only, TOTP as the default second factor (mirrors heimvio-green/docker/iam/01_login_policy.sh). Without this a fresh Zitadel keeps whatever the FirstInstance default or an external iam migration left behind — in production that was allowUsernamePassword=false, which renders the login-v2 form with no fields and locks out every password user. Runs on both install and reconfigure using the ephemeral admin PAT (persistent /bootstrap/admin-client.pat, same source as 340).
